title: RecommendationResponse
description: Output contract for ranked recommendations (Phase 0). Each item must correspond to a row from the candidate set in later phases; restaurant_id enables verification.

restaurant_id.description: Stable identifier from cleaned data (or canonical key) for grounding checks.

cuisine.description: Primary or joined cuisine labels for display.

estimated_cost.description: Human-readable cost (e.g. price band or currency range) copied from data when available.

ai_rationale.description: Short explanation tied to user preferences and visible attributes; must not invent facts not in data.

comparative_summary.description: Optional short comparison of top choices (problemstatement.md §4).

meta.description: Optional diagnostics: dataset_version, candidate_count, model id, etc.
